title: Omni Web3 Wallet
meta_description: Web3 super wallet: Built-in staking, yield vaults, bridges, swaps & NFT support
full_description: Omni is the Web 3 super app that allows you to do anything you want to do in Web 3 all in one place. - Multi-Chain Support: Forget using a different wallet for every chain. Omni supports more than 25 blockchains with no setup required.- 3 Tap Staking: stake your tokens in 3 simple taps with our groundbreaking Smart Delegation Protocol.- 3 Tap Yield Vaults: want to earn additional yields on your tokens? Omni offers yield vaults directly in the app.- Bridges and Swaps: Want to go from USDC on Ethereum to SOL on Solana? Or want to go from AVAX on Avalanche to BNB on BNB Chain? No problem! Omni supports all major bridges and DEXs natively so you can bridge and swap in one single transaction directly from your phone. Bridging and swapping has never been easier than with Omni! - Multi-chain NFT Support: Love your NFTs but hate how you need to have a different wallet for every chain your NFTs are on? No more! Omni brings all of your favorite NFTs into one place and allows you to manage and flex them all in one spot right on your phone.- Your Keys, Your Crypto: You are always in full control of your wallet and your crypto.- Wallet Import: No need to set up Omni as a new wallet. Simply import your wallets from MetaMask, Fantom, Keplr, and other wallets.- Hardware Wallet Support: Got a Ledger and don’t want to move your tokens off it? Simply sync your Ledger with Omni and seamlessly access and manage all of your tokens and NFTs on your phone while your keys always remain on your Ledger. There has never been a better way to manage your crypto!
